study.question: Can click-local nonlinear history compression and auxiliary aggregate projection jointly improve full-validation click AUC beyond the incumbent and both frozen sources while recovering auxiliary quality, at fixed capacity and measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: in r0052, block rather than aggregate projection raised click AUC0.668457308 to0.668526868 but reduced cart0.807915263 to0.804976960, fav0.819224284 to0.815070771 and buy0.830868755 to0.830498671 at identical32192421 parameters. This is a single-seed controlled task tradeoff, not replication. Nonlinear block dispersion may help click whereas aggregate smoothing may improve task-conditioned auxiliary readout and its shared-context training signal. Uniform projection placement across tasks may impose a harmful compromise. Retain block placement for click and move only cart/fav/buy to aggregate, with a full click-by-auxiliary placement factorial to test that explanation. r0082 extension gates improved some auxiliary AUCs but no cell beat the incumbent, so extra feedback capacity is not the current intervention.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version primary text lines264..283 verifies target-conditioned unnormalized local-activation pooling; lines317..335 describes Dice. We inherit the locally adapted scorer and Dice, adding no DIN reproduction claim. The intervention selects placement of the existing task-specific nonlinear history projection relative to block aggregation.

Pinned benchmark source lines123..219 uses task-mask-specific sequence hubs and repeated aggregation/broadcast. We do not add those hubs or layers; only label-identity selection between two existing projection placements at unchanged capacity. Original paper:infnet is link-only, so detailed original-paper equivalence/priority remains unverified.

Nearest local predecessor compares one common block/aggregate placement for every task crossed with context transfer. Current source retains later incumbent buy VJP and independently varies click versus auxiliary forward placement; r0052 cannot substitute for the new matched four-cell suite.

inherited_components: All incumbent categorical embeddings and original field/task information boundary
Action-aware unnormalized DIN scorer; uniform/feedback block compression; folded support training and pruned eval; five ID/position moment detail channels and mask/excluded-ID handling
Task-specific residual adapters, context queries, history projections, interaction outputs, product/live-RMS and task towers; existing parameter initialization and checkpoint/Dice state
Frozen context/scorer/item ownership and unweighted four-BCE; inherited first-order buy-summary removed_restored VJP, with click/cart/fav native
study.proposed_difference: Introduce two architecture-only placement choices selected by task label identity: primary_summary_placement and auxiliary_summary_placement, each block or aggregate. For b_j signed scored block contributions, M occupied blocks, shared details d and existing linear H_t, block summary is mean_j tanh(H_t([M*b_j,d])) over occupied blocks; aggregate summary is tanh(H_t([sum_j b_j,d])). Both already execute in the incumbent. Select one per task family while retaining the other with its zero coefficient. No added parameters, features, modules, state, random draws, loss hook or optimizer changes. BA is the prespecified candidate; BB, AA and AB are controls. legacy summary_placement remains block and is frozen to avoid ambiguous configurations.
predictions: BA exceeds BB click AUC0.668531811 and both frozen sources0.660646940/0.660163363, while improving cart/fav/buy AUC relative to fresh BB; any absent primary gain remains a null primary result.

At common nonzero state, changing only auxiliary placement changes no click output or isolated click-loss gradient. Trained click differences must arise through allowed shared training paths, not direct auxiliary readout into click.

Block versus aggregate differs for dispersed occupied blocks, agrees for singleton/homogeneous blocks and in the isolated linear limit. More-than16-history exploratory slices may show larger differences but do not prove the mechanism.

Capacity/state shapes/initialization and forward operation inventory are identical across cells; measured training/latency can vary and must be reported. The four-cell interaction separates task-specialized placement from a uniform placement preference.
falsifiers: BA fails to exceed the stronger of BB/AA in click or fails to improve beyond both frozen source bests; this falsifies useful complementarity for this implementation on the primary criterion.

Auxiliary aggregation does not recover auxiliary quality at fixed click placement, or useful recovery requires a click decrement; task-specific tradeoff explanation is not supported as a primary improvement.

BB does not reproduce incumbent/common-state predictions, gradients and buffers, gates leak unavailable information, or fixed parameter counts/initialization differ: integrity failure precludes scientific interpretation.
Effects vanish or reverse in later authorized paired seeds/user-cluster intervals. One selected validation improvement after many trials remains preliminary.
alternative_explanations: Single-seed stochastic/adaptive validation effects; incumbent buy-direction gain over native is only about0.000005 and is not itself established
Aggregate placement changes ordinary derivatives as well as dispersion sensitivity; tanh saturation and shared dense clipping can explain results without richer sequence understanding
Auxiliary whole-category/brand24h label semantics may favor smoothing independently of click representation; rare positives and task calibration differ
History-length/occupancy mixture or benchmark whole-window vocabulary/static snapshots can explain slice differences; no production point-in-time validity follows
The r0082 auxiliary improvements came with added capacity and altered losses through shared heads; they neither prove feedback complementarity nor refute all feedback modeling
